data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts that a rank-22 decomposition of <3,3,3> EXISTS, but provides no concrete construction, no formalization, and crucially has empty simulation_refs []. The problem explicitly warns: 'A simulation described in prose with an empty simulation_refs channel is an unverified claim and will be criticized as such.' The claim is also structurally unfalsifiable as stated: it posits existence while explaining away every failure to find it (all searches preserve symmetry, the decomposition breaks it). The countercondition asking for an exhaustive asymmetric search proving nonexistence would refute it, but the claim itself offers no discriminating experiment to support its positive existence assertion. The problem asks to 'conjecture concrete constructions or structural obstructions' — asserting bare existence with a post-hoc excuse for why nobody has found it is neither a concrete construction nor a testable obstruction without a filed simulation.
